sloka: अहम् आमंत्रये सर्वान् महर्षीन् पुण्य कर्मणः ।यज्ञ साह्य करान् राजन् ततो यक्ष्यसि निर्वृतः ॥१-५९-३॥
transliteration: aham āmaṁtraye sarvān maharṣīn puṇya karmaṇaḥ ।yajña sāhya karān rājan tato yakṣyasi nirvṛtaḥ ॥1-59-3॥

translations.english: O king I shall invite pious maharshis to assist you in the sacrifice which you will be able to perform with great relief.
